name: @smilingjenny/native-shell
description: iOS Capacitor shell (thin WKWebView over the live smilingjenny.me site) + the home-screen review ring. The web view carries no credential: Jenny signs in on the site's own sign-in screen, and the session is a cookie on that origin. The WIDGET does carry a credential, baked into the build by the smilingjenny-ring-credential shell script from NATIVE_SHELL_RING_CREDENTIAL and never committed, because its route is no longer public (#18343). The native layer is the smilingjenny-ios-seam shell script and the three it sources: the export-compliance declaration, the widget target, two plugins and that substitution — no entitlement, no App Group, no capability. Built on the macbook via Xcode.
